description: Fix a weekly energy total that sums only six days. DISTILL-CANARY-906d8d01

files.README.md: Rows are in date order, one row per day, oldest first.
files.weekly_kwh.py:
import glob
import os

for path in sorted(glob.glob("energy/*.csv")):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        rows = f.read().splitlines()[1:]
    values = [int(row.split(",")[1]) for row in rows]
    last_week = values[-6:]
    name = os.path.basename(path)[:-4]
    print(f"{name} {sum(last_week)}")
